concept.hr: SYN, SYN+ACK, ACK: potvrda je redni broj + 1, jer SYN zauzima jedan broj
concept.en: SYN, SYN+ACK, ACK: the ack is seq + 1, because the SYN takes one number

summary.hr: Klijent A i poslužitelj B usklađuju početne redne brojeve X i Y u tri poruke. Zašto B potvrđuje X+1, a ne X, i zašto su četiri koraka tri poruke.
summary.en: Client A and server B agree on initial sequence numbers X and Y in three messages. Why B acknowledges X+1, not X, and why four steps are three messages.

concept.hr: FIN i ACK u svakom smjeru; TIME-WAIT drži strana koja je prva zatvorila
concept.en: A FIN and an ACK in each direction; the end that closed first holds TIME-WAIT

concept.hr: Isti segmenti u zrcalu: TIME-WAIT je sad na poslužitelju
concept.en: The same segments mirrored: TIME-WAIT is now on the server

concept.hr: Nakon svojeg FIN-a strana i dalje prima podatke; druga smije slati
concept.en: After its FIN an end still receives data; the other end may still send

title.hr: TCP: FIN i ACK u jednom segmentu
title.en: TCP: FIN and ACK in one segment

concept.hr: Tri segmenta umjesto četiri: iz FIN-WAIT-1 ravno u TIME-WAIT
concept.en: Three segments instead of four: FIN-WAIT-1 straight to TIME-WAIT

concept.hr: FIN-ovi se mimoilaze: obje strane u CLOSING, pa obje u TIME-WAIT
concept.en: The FINs cross: both ends in CLOSING, then both in TIME-WAIT
